text:
NimbusGrid is a fast-growing fintech startup building high-throughput payments and reconciliation infrastructure for emerging markets. We process millions of transactions daily and need resilient, observable backend services that scale.

What you'll do
- Design, build and own backend services and APIs in Go for payment processing, reconciliation, settlement and reporting.
- Architect and implement fault-tolerant microservices with strong data consistency guarantees using PostgreSQL.
- Build and maintain service-to-service integration, event flows and async processing patterns to meet latency and throughput SLAs.
- Drive production readiness: monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, disaster recovery and incident response.
- Mentor engineers, perform code reviews, define backend standards and push improvements in deployment and CI/CD processes.
- Collaborate with product, SRE and data teams to translate requirements into robust technical designs.

What we need
- 8+ years of backend engineering experience.
- Strong production experience writing services in Go.
- Deep expertise with PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query optimization and migrations.
- Proven experience designing and operating Microservices at scale.
- Experience with observability (metrics, logging, tracing), testing strategies and CI/CD.
- Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, transactions and data consistency.
- Excellent communication and mentoring skills; ability to drive cross-team technical projects.

Bonus points
- Redis
- Docker
- gRPC

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
